name: infrastructure and edge
owns: everything in front of and around the application: CDN, proxy, load balancer, WAF, API gateway, serverless runtime, container, orchestrator and infrastructure as code
why_in_D: The edge is where policy is enforced, and it is a different implementation from the application. Every request is therefore seen twice by two programs that disagree. Those disagreements are the whole families of smuggling, cache poisoning and header trust bugs. The edge is also where the credentials live that can rebuild the environment.

factors.name: edge versus origin request interpretation
factors.def: whether the edge and the origin parse the same bytes the same way
factors.observable: a request the edge treats as benign and the origin treats as two

factors.name: WAF rule completeness against mutations
factors.def: whether the rule set covers encodings, contexts and chunking rather than exact strings
factors.observable: a payload that bypasses every rule and still works

factors.name: WAF normalisation before or after decoding
factors.def: whether inspection happens before or after URL and HTML decoding
factors.observable: a payload inspected in a different form than it is executed

factors.name: WAF body size inspection limit
factors.def: the size beyond which the body is not inspected and is forwarded anyway
factors.observable: an uninspected body accepted

factors.name: WAF content type inspection coverage
factors.def: which content types are parsed for inspection
factors.observable: a payload in a less common type passing through

factors.name: WAF fail open or closed behaviour
factors.def: what happens when the WAF cannot decide, times out or errors
factors.observable: a request forwarded during an inspection failure

factors.name: rate limit scope and keying
factors.def: what the limiter counts against: address, principal, route, or a combination
factors.observable: a limit bypassed by changing the counted property

factors.name: rate limiter state locality
factors.def: whether limits are enforced per edge node, which multiplies the effective allowance
factors.observable: aggregate throughput above the stated limit across nodes

factors.name: proxy to origin header addition
factors.def: which headers the edge adds, and whether the origin trusts them blindly
factors.observable: identity or scheme taken from an edge-added header

factors.name: origin reachability bypassing the edge
factors.def: whether the origin answers directly, which defeats every edge control
factors.observable: a response from the origin address without edge headers

factors.name: edge cache storage of authenticated responses
factors.def: whether a response to an authenticated request can enter a shared cache
factors.observable: one user's content served to another

factors.name: cache poisoning through unkeyed input
factors.def: whether a response depends on input that is not part of the cache key
factors.observable: a poisoned response served to a second client

factors.name: cache deception
factors.def: whether a non cacheable dynamic page can be stored by disguising it as a static asset
factors.observable: an authenticated page stored and served

factors.name: cache purge authority
factors.def: whether a purge can be triggered by an unauthorised party
factors.observable: a purge accepted from an untrusted request

factors.name: load balancer session affinity
factors.def: whether affinity is decided by a client controlled value
factors.observable: routing to a chosen backend through a supplied cookie

factors.name: backend health check exposure
factors.def: whether health endpoints leak versions, hosts or internal addresses
factors.observable: internal detail on a health route

factors.name: API gateway route authorisation default
factors.def: whether routes are open by default and require explicit protection
factors.observable: a route reachable without the expected policy

factors.name: gateway to lambda event shaping
factors.def: whether gateway metadata can influence the handler's idea of the request
factors.observable: a handler reading a field the client controlled

factors.name: serverless function URL exposure
factors.def: whether a function is directly addressable, bypassing the gateway
factors.observable: invocation through a function URL

factors.name: serverless cold start state
factors.def: whether state persists between invocations, which makes one tenant's data visible to another
factors.observable: a value from a previous invocation visible in a fresh one

factors.name: serverless timeout and retry semantics
factors.def: whether a function is retried on timeout, duplicating side effects
factors.observable: two effects from one intended invocation

factors.name: container image contents
factors.def: whether build tools, credentials or source are present in the shipped image
factors.observable: a credential or secret file in a layer

factors.name: container runtime privilege
factors.def: whether the container runs as root, with a writable root filesystem, or with extra capabilities
factors.observable: a capability or user beyond the minimum

factors.name: container escape path
factors.def: which kernel interfaces are reachable from the container, and whether any are host-mounted
factors.observable: a host path visible inside the container

factors.name: orchestrator API exposure
factors.def: whether the control plane API is reachable and how it authenticates
factors.observable: an API response from the cluster control plane

factors.name: service account token mounting
factors.def: whether a token is mounted into pods by default and what it can reach
factors.observable: a token usable against the API from inside a workload

factors.name: namespace and network policy coverage
factors.def: whether workloads are isolated or all talk to all by default
factors.observable: a connection permitted that the policy should deny

factors.name: secrets store access from workload
factors.def: which secrets a workload can read, and whether that matches its purpose
factors.observable: a secret readable outside its intended consumer

factors.name: infrastructure as code execution context
factors.def: whether a plan or apply can be triggered from a pull request by an outsider
factors.observable: a change applied from an untrusted contribution

factors.name: state file contents and accessibility
factors.def: whether the terraform or equivalent state holds secrets and who can read it
factors.observable: a secret in the state file

factors.name: cloud metadata service reachability
factors.def: whether a workload or a page can reach instance metadata and obtain credentials
factors.observable: credentials returned by a metadata request

factors.name: metadata service version and header requirement
factors.def: whether the newer protected mode is enforced or the older open mode remains
factors.observable: a request accepted without the required token

factors.name: IAM role assumption conditions
factors.def: whether trust policies restrict who can assume, and by which condition keys
factors.observable: an assumption permitted under a condition it should fail

factors.name: policy wildcard breadth
factors.def: whether a policy grants a wildcard action or resource
factors.observable: a permission beyond the documented need

factors.name: cross account trust
factors.def: whether a role accepts principals from another account broadly
factors.observable: an assumption from an unintended account

factors.name: storage bucket policy default
factors.def: whether a bucket is private by default and whether a policy change is detectable
factors.observable: an object readable anonymously

factors.name: egress filtering
factors.def: whether a workload can reach arbitrary internet hosts, which enables exfiltration and callback
factors.observable: a connection to an unlisted host

factors.name: DNS resolution inside the perimeter
factors.def: whether internal names resolve publicly, revealing topology
factors.observable: an internal hostname resolving from outside

factors.name: load balancer host header routing
factors.def: whether routing depends on a client supplied host, permitting virtual host confusion
factors.observable: a request for one site answered by another's backend

factors.name: shared ingress default backend
factors.def: what answers when no route matches, which often leaks the ingress software and version
factors.observable: a default 404 page identifying the software

factors.name: deployment pipeline secrets exposure
factors.def: whether pipeline logs or artefacts carry credentials
factors.observable: a credential in a build log

factors.name: blue green and canary split integrity
factors.def: whether a client can choose which deployment it reaches
factors.observable: an old version reached by a client-supplied property

factors.name: feature flag service trust
factors.def: whether flag evaluation takes identity from the client
factors.observable: a flag enabled by a client-supplied attribute

factors.name: config endpoint exposure
factors.def: whether configuration is served to clients with more than it needs
factors.observable: an internal URL or key in client config

factors.name: observability stack access
factors.def: whether tracing and metric endpoints are public and what they reveal
factors.observable: internal transaction data from a public endpoint

factors.name: backup and snapshot network exposure
factors.def: whether snapshots are reachable from the network or from a lower trust account
factors.observable: a snapshot read from a lower trust context

factors.name: dns zone transfer and record exposure
factors.def: whether the zone permits transfer or reveals internal records
factors.observable: a record listing obtained

factors.name: certificate issuance authority
factors.def: whether an attacker can obtain a certificate for a name the organisation controls
factors.observable: a valid certificate for an unintended subdomain

factors.name: subdomain takeover surface
factors.def: whether a dangling record points at a claimable resource
factors.observable: a response served from a service the organisation no longer owns

factors.name: staging environment separation
factors.def: whether staging shares credentials, data or DNS with production
factors.observable: a production credential valid in staging

factors.name: debug and admin port exposure
factors.def: whether management interfaces are bound to a public address
factors.observable: an admin port answering externally

factors.name: container registry access control
factors.def: whether images are readable and whether an unsigned image can be pulled
factors.observable: an image pulled without authentication

factors.name: admission control coverage
factors.def: whether the cluster rejects privileged or unlabelled workloads
factors.observable: a workload admitted that policy should refuse

factors.name: resource limit absence
factors.def: whether a workload can consume unbounded CPU or memory, which is a denial of the whole node
factors.observable: one workload degrading a neighbour

factors.name: autoscaling as a cost channel
factors.def: whether a request pattern can force scale out and cost
factors.observable: instance count growth from a request pattern

factors.name: queue depth as a backpressure channel
factors.def: whether flooding one endpoint stalls an unrelated consumer
factors.observable: unrelated latency caused by targeted load

factors.name: connection limit per client
factors.def: whether one client can exhaust a shared connection pool
factors.observable: denial of other clients from one source

factors.name: timeout budget composition
factors.def: whether chained timeouts sum above the front door's limit, leaving work running after the client gave up
factors.observable: a backend action completing after the client timed out

factors.name: retry storm amplification
factors.def: whether retries at several layers multiply load on a failing dependency
factors.observable: request amplification of a single client action

factors.name: circuit breaker behaviour under attack
factors.def: whether an attacker can trip a breaker and deny a service to everyone
factors.observable: service unavailable to all clients after targeted failure

factors.name: edge logging coverage
factors.def: which requests are recorded, which decides whether a probe is visible
factors.observable: absence of a request from edge logs

factors.name: incident tooling access
factors.def: whether break glass credentials and runbooks are reachable by the same identity as normal operations
factors.observable: an elevated credential available without a second approval
